The '''Ugnaught Spit''' was a type of cheap [[Liquor/Legends|liquor]] made by [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] and sold in the [[Four-and-a-Half]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] between level 124 and 125 of the [[City/Legends|city]].
